pages.text: Statistics, information and computation: how sure, how much, and how long.

$(thing)Statistics$(): the $(item)Statistics Engine$() samples until it is sure. Set the sample size and the confidence: the margin z·σ/√n must be under the recipe's tolerance. It makes the $(item)Confidence Seal$() upgrade (every chance product halfway closer to certain). $(thing)Regression$() gives Assayed Enzymes from the statistics alone; $(thing)Stochastic Kinetics$() counts Microstate Tallies in bulk. Its calibration: prove it.

$(thing)Information Theory$(): the $(item)Cipher Loom$() weaves Hamming codes. Set the block length and the check bits: the code must cover the block, and blocks that fail must be rarer than the recipe allows. It makes the $(item)Error-Correcting Code$() upgrade (catalysts wear on only every other run) and, with $(thing)Cryptography$(), $(item)One-Time Pads$(), which tune Entanglement Tuners two at a time. Its calibration: break a cipher.
$(thing)Algorithms$() and $(thing)Computability$(): how much work a recipe takes, and what no machine can ever decide.
